description: Fires right after the opponent drops a stone into column 2 (third column from the left), mainly when that stone lands on top of my own stones there: the more of my stones in column 2, the stronger; the opponent's own earlier column-2 stones weaken it. It is strongly timing-dependent: weak in the first ~12 moves, strongest around moves 16-22, fading slowly later. Moves in any other column never fire it.
effect: None measurable: zeroing or maxing it shifts move probabilities by at most ~5-7 points, with no consistent direction.
notes: Layer-0 unit; all firing has last move in col 2. Minimal pairs: same col-2 move flips 0.1 -> 3.5 depending on whether stones below are mine or theirs; ply curve peaks ~18-20. Program estimates activation from ply, my and their col-2 stone counts. Best dev F1 0.720 (P 0.59, R 0.92), AUROC 0.95, sim share 0.99. Unmodelled: other-column token effects (+-0.4) cause most false positives near threshold. Steering effect negligible. Synth reaches 7.29 vs dev max 5.48.
